_comment: Hero personalities shape how they pick dungeons, what they buy and how they change after close calls. boldness shifts the minimum success chance they accept (negative = braver).

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.desc: Charges into the deepest halls. Loves cursed steel.

cautious.name: Cautious
cautious.desc: Picks safe fights, values armor, never touches cursed gear.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.desc: Haggles hard and always goes back for more treasure.

glory.name: Glory-Seeker
glory.desc: Chases bounties and bosses; pays extra to look the part.

steady.name: Steady
steady.desc: Reliable and loyal once won over.
